decision.explanation: Two distinct claims about Tadao Takashima's spouse appear in the provided sources. Document d1 (D1S2) states that he was married to Hanayo Sumi, citing confirmation from multiple sources and official records from the Japanese Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare. Document d2 (D2S7) asserts that he married Evelyn Herbert Webb in 1965. These two claims refer to different individuals and are presented independently in their respective documents. Since there is no explicit contradiction within the same document or clear evidence of error in either claim, both are preserved as valid referents under the principle that distinct valid namesakes and complementary answers may coexist.
